UserProgressDocument.title: UserProgressDocument
UserProgressDocument.description: Cloud-synced learner progress and study metrics for an authenticated BhashaSetu user.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the learner who owns this progress record.

displayName.description: Learner display name (non-PII first name or alias).

selectedLevel.description: Active CEFR track selected by the learner.

dailyGoalMinutes.description: Daily study goal in minutes (5 to 120).

currentStreakDays.description: Current consecutive days of study streak.

sprintHighScore.description: Highest score achieved in the 60-second phonics sprint.

completedUnitIdsCount.description: Total number of completed lecture units.

masteredWordsCount.description: Unified mastered vocabulary count across SRS and lectures.

progressSnapshot.description: Bounded structured map containing completedUnitIds, savedWordIds, masteredWordIds, wordSRS, mistakeNotebook, lectureNotes, and studyActivityByDate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud profile was last synchronized.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated per-user learning progress, SRS state, and study milestones keyed strictly by the owner's UID.
